= Forge Calculator =

The '''Forge Calculator''' (also known as '''Little Timmy's Calculator''') is a DPS calculation spreadsheet for the Forge game. It computes total average DPS by combining physical hits, on-hit traits (explosion, fire, poison, smite, black hole, lightning), and special modifiers (berserk, moon stone).

This page documents every formula, cell reference, and mechanic in the current version of the calculator, synced to the latest spreadsheet.

== Overview ==

The calculator takes the following inputs:
* '''4 ore slots''' (C6:C9) — ore name, amount (D6:D9)
* '''Weapon selection''' (D12) and '''enhancement level''' (C13, 0–9)
* '''Weapon quality''' (E12, %)
* '''Race''' (C22) and '''race trait''' (C22–C23)
* '''3 rune slots''' (C27:D29) — stat text pairs
* '''Rune abilities''' (C34:E37) — manual inputs for Fire/Poison/Lightning/Blast DMG, proc chance, and cooldown
* '''Armor bonuses''' (C42:C44) — manual inputs for Crit Chance, Crit DMG, Lethality
* '''Crit Chance Bonus''' (C46) — manual input (default 0.05)
* '''Atk Speed Bonus''' (C48) — manual input (default 0.06)
* '''Berserk Bonus''' (C54) — manual input
* '''Achievement''' (C85) — dropdown selection

It outputs '''Total Average DPS''' (C96) as the sum of 7 components:
# Physical Hit DPS (C89)
# Explosion DPS (C90)
# Fire DoT DPS (C91)
# Poison DoT DPS (C92)
# Smite DPS (C93)
# Black Hole DPS (C94)
# Lightning DPS (E94) — '''NEW'''

And special-case totals:
* '''Berserk DPS''' (C97) — Lethality and Berserk are multiplicative
* '''Moon Stone DPS''' (C98) — Moon is multiplicative on physical only
* '''Min DPS''' (C100) — no crits, base hits only
* '''Max Burst DPS''' (C101) — all crits + all procs

== Ore Multiplier Lookup ==

Each ore slot (C6–C9) looks up its multiplier from the [[_OptionsCrafter]] sheet:

 '''E6:''' =IF(C6="Select Ore",1,IFERROR(VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(VLOOKUP(C6,'_OptionsCrafter'!$A$55:$C$202,3,0),"x","")),1))

The VLOOKUP range is '''$A$55:$C$202''' (expanded from $A$55:$C$195 to accommodate 7 new ores).

=== Weighted Ore Average ===

The weighted average multiplier (E10) '''excludes Fichilliumorite''':

 '''E10:''' =IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(D6:D9, E6:E9, (C6:C9<>"Fichilliumorite")*1) / SUMIFS(D6:D9, C6:C9, "<>Fichilliumorite"), AVERAGEIFS(E6:E9, C6:C9, "<>Fichilliumorite"))

If all 4 ore slots are Fichilliumorite (denominator = 0), it falls back to AVERAGEIFS of the non-Fichilliumorite multipliers.

'''Fichilliumorite''' has a 1x multiplier and provides no combat traits. It is intentionally excluded from the weighted average so it doesn't dilute weapon damage.

=== Ore Type & Power Scaling ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Cell !! Formula !! Description
|-
| I6–I9 || <code>IF(C6="Select Ore",0,IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("eapon",VLOOKUP(C6,'_OptionsCrafter'!$A$55:$F$202,2,0))),1,0))</code> || Returns 1 if ore is a Weapon ore
|-
| J6–J9 || <code>D6/SUM($D$6:$D$9)</code> || Ore's share fraction of total ore amount
|-
| K6–K9 || <code>IF(OR(I6=0,J6<0.1),0,MIN(MAX((J6-0.1)*4.5+0.1,0.1),1))</code> || Power scaling: 0 if non-weapon or <10%, then linear from 10%→0.1 to ~32%→1, capped 0.1–1
|-
| L6–L9 || <code>IF(K6=0,"",IF(J6>=0.3,VLOOKUP(full trait text),"[X% power] "&VLOOKUP(partial trait)))</code> || Shows full trait at ≥30%, otherwise power-scaled partial
|}

== Weapon Stats ==

=== Base Weapon Damage ===

 '''A18:''' =IFERROR(VLOOKUP(D12,'_Weapon'!$C$2:$E$81,3,0)*E10*(1+E12/100),1)

Looks up base weapon damage from the [[_Weapon]] table (range $C$2:$E$81), multiplies by weighted ore average (E10) and quality bonus (1+E12/100).

=== Enhanced Weapon Damage ===

 '''C18:''' =IFERROR(VLOOKUP(D12,'_Weapon'!$C$2:$E$81,3,0)*E10*SWITCH(C13,0,1,1,1.05,2,1.1,3,1.15,4,1.2,5,1.25,6,1.3,7,1.35,8,1.4,9,1.5,1)*(1+E12/100),1)

Enhancement level multipliers (0–9): +0%, +5%, +10%, +15%, +20%, +25%, +30%, +35%, +40%, +50%.

=== Attack Speed ===

 '''C19:''' =IFERROR(VLOOKUP(D12,'_Weapon'!$C$2:$E$81,2,0),1)
 '''E18:''' =1/C19
 '''E20:''' =C19/(1+E48)
 '''E21:''' =1/E20

Base attack speed from weapon table → hits per second → effective speed with atk speed bonus → effective hits per second.

== Armor Bonuses ==

New in the current version: armor bonus cells (C42–C44) are '''manual inputs''' that feed into stat totals.

{| class="wikitable"
! Cell !! Cap !! Description
|-
| C42 → E42 || MIN(C42, 100%) || Crit Chance armor bonus
|-
| C43 → E43 || MIN(C43, 100%) || Crit DMG armor bonus
|-
| C44 → E44 || MIN(C44, 150%) || Lethality armor bonus (sealed curse, eye ore, vanegos, fierce jade, frost fossil, kokorite armor)
|}

== Stat Bonuses from Ores ==

All ore-based stat bonuses use a '''standard scaling formula''':

  IF(D6/SUM($D$6:$D$9)<0.1, 0, (base% + (max% - base%) * MIN((share - 0.1) / 0.2, 1)) / 100)

* '''10% minimum threshold''' — no bonus if ore share < 10%
* '''Linear scaling''' from 10% share to 30% share (0.2 range)
* '''Maximum bonus''' at ≥30% share

=== Lethality ===

 '''C45:''' =IFS(…each ore slot…) + C44
 '''E45:''' =MIN(A27 + A45 + C45 + race_bonus + achievement_bonus, 150%)

== Extra Traits ==

=== Moon Stone ===

 '''C53:''' =IFS(…Moon Stone per slot…) (scales 2.5%–25%)
 '''E53:''' =1 + C53

Moon Stone provides a multiplicative bonus to physical DPS only. It does not affect on-hit traits.

=== Berserk ===

 '''C54:''' 0.0 (manual input)
 '''E54:''' =C54 + IF(C22="Minotaur", 30%, 0)

Minotaur race provides +30% Berserk.

== On-Hit Traits ==

=== Explosion ===

 '''C58:''' =IFS(…each ore slot…) + C37 (Blast rune input)
 '''C59:''' =MAX(…each ore slot…) + D37 (Blast proc input)
 '''E58:''' =A18 * C58 (Explosion DMG per proc)
 '''E59:''' =A18 * C58 * C59 * E21 (Explosion DPS)

{| class="wikitable"
! Ore !! DMG Min–Max !! Proc Min–Max
|-
| Gargantuan || 5%–50% || 3.5%–35%
|-
| Magmaite || 3.5%–35% || 2%–20%
|-
| Meteorite || 6%–60% || 2.5%–25%
|-
| Supermassive Black Hole || 6.5%–65% || 4.5%–45%
|-
| '''Kitsunite''' || 7%–70% || 4%–40%
|}

'''Formula:''' Explosion DPS = BaseDMG × ExplosionDMG% × ProcChance × Hits/sec

=== Fire DoT ===

 '''C62:''' =IFS(…each ore slot…) + IF(Dragonborn, +30%, 0) + C34 (Fire rune input)
 '''C63:''' =MAX(…each ore slot…) + IF(Dragonborn, +40%, 0) + D34 (Fire proc input)
 '''C64:''' =SUM(…fire duration calc…) (capped)
 '''E62:''' =A18 * C62 (Fire DMG/sec per proc)
 '''E63:''' =IF(E21=0, 0, A18 * C62 * MIN(1, C63 * E21 * MIN(C64, 5))) (Fire DPS — refreshing)
 '''E64:''' =MAX(A18 * C62 * (C64 + 1), 0) (Fire total DMG per proc)

{| class="wikitable"
! Ore !! DMG Min–Max !! Proc Min–Max !! Duration Min–Max
|-
| Gargantuan || 2%–20% || 2%–20% || 0.2s–2s
|-
| Sun Stone || 3.5%–35% || 3.5%–35% || 0.5s–5s
|-
| Fireite || 2%–20% || 2%–20% || 0.2s–2s
|-
| Kyubite || 4.5%–45% || 4.5%–45% || 0.5s–5s
|-
| Supermassive Black Hole || 5%–50% || 4.5%–45% || 0.5s–5s
|-
| '''Kitsunite''' || 4%–40% || 5%–50% || 0.5s–5s
|}

Dragonborn adds +30% fire DMG, +40% fire proc, and +3 seconds base fire duration.

Fire DPS accounts for refreshing DoTs: capped at 1 effective proc per hit, with duration capped at 5 seconds.
First tick is instant, so total DMG per proc = FireDMG × (Duration + 1).

=== Poison DoT ===

 '''C67:''' =IFS(…Malachite per slot…) + D34 (carried input)
 '''C68:''' =MAX(…Malachite per slot…) + D35 (Poison proc input)
 '''C69:''' =MAX(0, MAX(XLOOKUP("Malachite",…), E35) - 2) (Poison Duration — array formula)
 '''E67:''' =A18 * C67 (Poison DMG/sec per proc)
 '''E68:''' =IF(E21=0, 0, A18 * C67 * MIN(1, C68 * E21 * MIN(C69, 5))) (Poison DPS)
 '''E69:''' =MAX(A18 * C67 * (C69 + 1), 0) (Poison total DMG per proc)

{| class="wikitable"
! Ore !! DMG Min–Max !! Proc Min–Max !! Duration Min–Max
|-
| Malachite || 1%–10% || 3.3%–33% || 0.3s–3s (then -2s application offset)
|}

Poison Duration (C69) uses an '''XLOOKUP/BYROW/LAMBDA array formula''':

  XLOOKUP("Malachite", $C$6:$C$9, BYROW($D$6:$D$9, LAMBDA(row, IF(SUM($D$6:$D$9)=0, 0, IF(row/SUM($D$6:$D$9)<0.1, 0, 0.3+2.7*MIN((row/SUM($D$6:$D$9)-0.1)/0.2, 1))))), 0)

Duration is then calculated as MAX(duration_value, 0) - 2 seconds (application timing offset). E35 adds rune duration.

=== Smite ===

 '''C72:''' =IFS(…each ore slot…) + IF(Angel, +30%, 0) + IF(Archangel, MIN(FLOOR(E21,1)*0.5, 1.5), 0)
 '''C73:''' =MAX(…each ore slot…) + IFS(Angel=50%, Archangel=33%, else=0)
 '''E72:''' =A18 * C72 (Smite DMG per proc)
 '''E73:''' =A18 * E21 * C72 * MIN(C73, 1) (Smite DPS)

{| class="wikitable"
! Ore !! DMG Min–Max !! Proc Min–Max
|-
| Heavenite || 2.5%–25% || 4%–40%
|-
| '''Kitsunite''' || 2.5%–50% (capped MIN 5%, MAX 50%) || 5%–50%
|}

'''Archangel Smite Scaling''' — '''MAJOR CHANGE''': The Archangel smite bonus now '''scales with attack speed''':

  MIN(FLOOR(E21, 1) * 0.5, 1.5)

* At 1 hit/sec: +50% smite DMG
* At 2 hits/sec: +100% smite DMG
* At 3+ hits/sec: +150% smite DMG (capped)

Previously this was a flat +150% regardless of attack speed.

Smite DPS = BaseDMG × Hits/sec × SmiteDMG% × MIN(ProcChance, 100%). Note: Smite DPS uses E21 directly, not MIN(hits/sec, 1/cooldown).

=== Black Hole ===

 '''C76:''' =IFS(…Galaxite per slot…) (6%–60%)
 '''C77:''' =IF(COUNTIF(C6:C9, "Galaxite")/COUNTA(C6:C9)>=0.1, 0.3, 0) (30% proc if ≥10% Galaxite)
 '''E77:''' =E13 * C77 * C82 * MIN(E21, 1) (Black Hole DPS)

'''Formula restructured:''' Black Hole DPS = WeaponDMG (E13, =A18) × ProcChance × C82 × MIN(Hits/sec, 1).

'''Important:''' C82 is currently '''empty''' (evaluates to 0), making Black Hole DPS = 0. C82 appears to be a planned '''Black Hole Radius''' multiplier (per Galaxite's description: "+6.5% Black Hole Radius"). This cell needs to be populated for Black Hole DPS to function.

=== Lightning / Freeze ===

'''NEW SECTION''' — Lightning/Freezing DPS was added in the current version.

 '''C80:''' =IFS(…each ore slot…) + C36 (Lightning rune input) — Lightning DMG%
 '''E80:''' =SUM(…cooldown calc…) — Lightning Cooldown (seconds)
 '''C81:''' =MAX(…each ore slot…) + D36 (Lightning proc input) — Lightning Proc Chance%
 '''E81:''' =IFERROR(E13 * C80 * C81 * MIN(E21, 1/E80), 0) — Lightning DPS

{| class="wikitable"
! Ore !! DMG Min–Max !! Proc Min–Max !! Cooldown Min–Max
|-
| '''Kitsunite''' || 8%–80% || 6%–60% || 0.3s–3s
|-
| '''Marblite''' || 6%–60% || 4%–40% || 0.5s–5s
|}

'''Formula:''' Lightning DPS = BaseDMG × LightningDMG% × ProcChance × MIN(Hits/sec, 1/Cooldown)

The MIN(Hits/sec, 1/Cooldown) ensures Lightning cannot proc faster than its cooldown allows. IFERROR returns 0 if no lightning ore is present.

== Achievements ==

 '''C85:''' Achievement dropdown (moved from C80)
 '''E85:''' =IFS(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("Attack Speed",C85)),"Total AS: "&TEXT(E48,"0%"), ISNUMBER(SEARCH("Crit Chance",C85)),"Total CC: "&TEXT(E46,"0%"), ISNUMBER(SEARCH("Damage Boost",C85)),"Total Lethality: "&TEXT(E45,"0%"), TRUE,"No bonus selected")

Achievement bonuses apply to the relevant stat (Atk Speed, Crit Chance, or Lethality) and are parsed from the achievement text.

== DPS Results ==

=== Physical Hit DPS (C89) ===

  C89 = C18 × (1 + E45) × (MIN(C20 + E46, 1) × (C21 + E47) + (1 - MIN(C20 + E46, 1))) × E21

Breakdown:
* C18 = Enhanced weapon damage
* E45 = Total Lethality (capped 150%)
* C20 + E46 = Total Crit Chance (capped 100%)
* C21 + E47 = Total Crit Multiplier (capped 100%)
* E21 = Effective hits per second

The crit blend formula: CritChance × CritMulti + (1 - CritChance) = average damage multiplier from crits.

=== On-Hit DPS Components ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Component !! Cell !! Formula Source
|-
| Explosion DPS || C90 = E59 || BaseDMG × Explosion% × Proc% × Hits/sec
|-
| Fire DoT DPS || C91 = E63 || BaseDMG × Fire% × MIN(1, Proc×Hits×Duration)
|-
| Poison DoT DPS || C92 = E68 || BaseDMG × Poison% × MIN(1, Proc×Hits×Duration)
|-
| Smite DPS || C93 = E73 || BaseDMG × Hits/sec × Smite% × MIN(Proc, 1)
|-
| Black Hole DPS || C94 = E77 || WeaponDMG × Proc% × Radius× MIN(Hits/sec, 1)
|-
| Lightning DPS || E94 = E81 || WeaponDMG × Lightning% × Proc% × MIN(Hits/sec, 1/Cooldown)
|}

=== Total Average DPS (C96) ===

  C96 = C89 + C90 + C91 + C92 + C93 + C94 + E94

'''7 components''' (was 6 before Lightning was added).

=== Time to Kill ===

 '''E96:''' =IF(C96>0, 25000/C96, "∞") — vs Golem (25,000 HP)
 '''E97:''' =IF(C96>0, 75000/C96, "∞") — vs Asura's Incarnate (75,000 HP)

=== Berserk DPS (C97) ===

  C97 = IF(E54=0, C96, (C90+C91+C92+C93+C94+E94 + C18×(1+MIN(E45,150%))×(1+E54)×CritBlend×E21))

'''MAJOR CHANGE:''' Lethality and Berserk are now '''multiplicative''' not additive:
* Old: MIN(E44+E53, 150%) — combined Leth+Berserk into one additive cap
* New: (1 + MIN(E45, 150%)) × (1 + E54) — separate multipliers

If Berserk bonus is 0, Berserk DPS equals Total DPS.

=== Moon Stone DPS (C98) ===

  C98 = IF(C53=0, C96, C89×(1+C53) + C90+C91+C92+C93+C94+E94)

Moon Stone is '''multiplicative on physical DPS only''' — on-hit traits are added unchanged.

=== Min DPS (C100) ===

  C100 = C18 × (1 + E45) × E21

Base weapon damage with lethality but no crits, no on-hit.

=== Max Burst DPS (C101) ===

  C101 = C18×(1+E45)×(C21+E47)×E21 + C18×C58×E21 + C18×C62 + C18×C67 + C72×C18 + C76×C18 + C80

All crits + all on-hit procs firing simultaneously.

== Rune System ==

=== Rune Stat Parsing ===

3 rune slots (C27:D29), each with 2 stat text fields. The parser extracts numeric values from stat text:

* '''A27:''' Total Lethality from runes (parses "Lethality" from all 6 rune cells)
* '''A28:''' Total Crit Chance from runes
* '''A29:''' Total Crit DMG from runes
* '''A30/A31:''' Total Atk Speed from runes

 '''C30:''' =TEXT(A27*100,"0.0")&"% Leth  +"&TEXT(A28*100,"0.0")&"% CC  +"&TEXT(A29*100,"0.0")&"% CD  +"&TEXT(A30*100,"0.0")&"% AS"

== Changelog Summary ==

=== New Ores ===
* '''Fierce Jade''' (17x) — +2%/20% Lethality, +2%/20% Crit DMG, +3.5%/35% Crit Chance, conditional Physical DMG/Speed buff
* '''Vanegos''' (19.5x) — +4%/40% Lethality
* '''Kitsunite''' (27.5x) — Multi-trait: Explosion, Fire, Smite, and Lightning
* '''Marblite''' (18x) — Lightning/Freeze DPS
* '''Fichilliumorite''' (1x) — Neutral ore, excluded from weighted average

=== New DPS Component ===
* '''Lightning/Freeze DPS''' (E94 = E81) — 7th component added to Total DPS

=== Major Formula Changes ===
* '''Fichilliumorite excluded from weighted average''' (E10 uses SUMPRODUCT with exclusion filter + SUMIFS/AVERAGEIFS)
* '''Archangel smite bonus scales with attack speed''': MIN(FLOOR(E21,1)*0.5, 1.5) instead of flat +150%
* '''Berserk DPS now multiplicative''': (1+Lethality) × (1+Berserk) instead of combined additive
* '''Black Hole DPS restructured''': references C82 (Black Hole Radius multiplier, currently empty → BH DPS = 0)
* '''Poison Duration (C69) rewritten''': XLOOKUP/BYROW/LAMBDA array formula replaces manual IFS stack
* '''C46 (Crit Chance Bonus) and C48 (Atk Speed Bonus)''': changed from ore-based IFS formulas to manual input cells
* '''VLOOKUP ranges expanded''': $A$55:$C$195 → $A$55:$C$202; $C$2:$E$80 → $C$2:$E$81
* '''"Tigers Eye" → "Tiger's Eye"''': apostrophe added
* '''Achievement cell''': moved from C80 to C85
